  <h2>About Me</h2>
  <p>
    I am a second-year Master of Public Health student in Biostatistics at Emory University's Rollins
    School of Public Health, graduating in May 2026. My work sits at the intersection of statistical
    methodology and biological data — translating complex datasets into interpretable, reproducible findings
    that can inform real-world decisions.
  </p>
  <p>
    I have hands-on experience in large-scale transcriptomics, clinical trial analysis, and bioinformatics
    pipeline development. I enjoy building tools that make statistical results accessible: from interactive
    Shiny dashboards to end-to-end reproducible workflows using Docker and Make.
  </p>
  <p>
    I am actively seeking full-time roles in biostatistics, data science, or statistical programming
    starting Summer 2026.
